boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe outings around Pepperdine and Malibu with no required admission or purchase. Check trail conditions and parking rules before leaving campus.

cards.entity_name: Frederick R. Weisman Museum of Art
cards.title: Look through contemporary art at the Weisman
cards.subtitle: Pepperdine Malibu Campus · 24255 Pacific Coast Highway
cards.notes: Meet at the gallery, choose a few works to discuss, then use the museum’s digital guide for a self-paced second look.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission museum stop on Pepperdine’s Malibu campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine states that admission to the Frederick R. Weisman Museum of Art is free.
cards.source_title: Lisa Smith Wengler Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Sunday, 11 AM–5 PM according to the museum site; confirm exhibition dates before visiting.

cards.title: Walk to Solstice Canyon’s waterfall and ruins
cards.subtitle: Solstice Canyon · Malibu
cards.notes: Bring water and take the gentle canyon route together; pause at the waterfall and Roberts Ranch House ruins before heading back.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Park Service identifies Solstice Canyon Trail as an easy 2.1-mile round trip to a waterfall and Roberts Ranch House ruins.
cards.source_title: Hiking — Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area
cards.access_notes: NPS states that Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area has no entrance fee or required entrance pass; parking terms can vary.

cards.title: Listen for wildlife in Zuma Canyon
cards.subtitle: Zuma and Trancas Canyons · near Zuma Beach
cards.notes: Use the Zuma Canyon Trailhead and make this a slow wildlife-spotting walk; stay on marked trails and keep the group together.
cards.short_summary: A trail outing among canyon streams and chaparral.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Park Service lists hiking and wildlife viewing among activities at Zuma and Trancas Canyons.
cards.source_title: Zuma and Trancas Canyons — Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area
cards.access_notes: NPS states that Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area has no entrance fee or required entrance pass; follow posted trail conditions.

cards.title: Take a picnic-and-birding break in Cheeseboro
cards.subtitle: Cheeseboro/Palo Comado Canyon · Agoura
cards.notes: Pack food from home, pick an oak-shaded picnic spot, and bring binoculars for a shared birdwatching loop on designated trails.
cards.short_summary: A free trailhead, picnic area, and birdwatching outing.
cards.evidence_claim: NPS lists picnicking and birdwatching at Cheeseboro/Palo Comado Canyon and says its main parking is free.
cards.source_title: Cheeseboro/Palo Comado Canyon — Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area
cards.access_notes: The NPS page says the main parking lot is free and open 8 AM to sunset; the recreation area has no entrance fee.

cards.title: Trace the film-history trails at Paramount Ranch
cards.subtitle: Paramount Ranch · Agoura Hills
cards.notes: Choose an easy multi-use trail, notice the oak savannah, and compare film-history details with what you see on the ground.
cards.short_summary: A public NPS ranch with hiking trails and film history.
cards.evidence_claim: NPS says Paramount Ranch offers easy to moderate scenic hikes and opportunities to learn about film history.
cards.source_title: Paramount Ranch — Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area
cards.access_notes: NPS states that Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area has no entrance fee or required entrance pass; obey any construction detours.

cards.entity_name: Santa Monica Mountains Anthony C. Beilenson Interagency Visitor Center
cards.title: Explore the exhibits at the Beilenson Visitor Center
cards.subtitle: King Gillette Ranch · Calabasas
cards.notes: Start with the interactive exhibits and park film, then use the ranger information to choose a nearby walk that fits your group.
cards.short_summary: A museum-style visitor center inside King Gillette Ranch.
cards.evidence_claim: NPS describes interactive exhibits and a small theater at the Anthony C. Beilenson Interagency Visitor Center.
cards.source_title: Santa Monica Mountains Anthony C. Beilenson Interagency Visitor Center
cards.access_notes: NPS lists the visitor center as open Wednesday–Sunday, 9 AM–4 PM, with a two-hour free main-lot parking limit.

cards.title: Stroll the grasslands on the Satwiwa Loop
cards.subtitle: Rancho Sierra Vista/Satwiwa · Newbury Park
cards.notes: Take the easy loop at conversation pace, stop for the Mount Boney backdrop, and leave enough daylight for the return trip.
cards.short_summary: A 1.5-mile loop through grasslands and chaparral.
cards.evidence_claim: NPS identifies Satwiwa Loop Trail as an easy 1.5-mile walk through the Satwiwa Native American Indian Natural Area.
cards.source_title: Hiking — Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area
cards.access_notes: NPS states that Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area has no entrance fee or required entrance pass; check site conditions first.

cards.title: Plan a Split Rock hike on Mishe Mokwa Trail
cards.subtitle: Circle X Ranch · Santa Monica Mountains
cards.notes: Wear sturdy shoes, bring water, and use the trail’s oak-grove stop for a group break rather than rushing the route.
cards.short_summary: A 3.5-mile round-trip hike to Split Rock.
cards.evidence_claim: NPS describes Mishe Mokwa Trail to Split Rock as a moderate 3.5-mile round-trip hike with canyon views and an oak grove.
cards.source_title: Hiking — Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area
cards.access_notes: NPS states that Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area has no entrance fee or required entrance pass; review weather and trail notices.

cards.title: Pick a daytime segment of the Backbone Trail
cards.subtitle: Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area
cards.notes: Choose a short out-and-back section with the group, set a turnaround time, and save the longer route for another day.
cards.short_summary: A long-distance trail suited to self-planned day segments.
cards.evidence_claim: NPS describes the Backbone Trail as a 65-mile route that many people complete over multiple day trips.
cards.source_title: Hiking — Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area
cards.access_notes: NPS states that the recreation area has no entrance fee or required entrance pass; the Backbone Trail crosses multiple land jurisdictions, so check segment rules.

cards.title: Register for a free Charmlee sunset hike
cards.subtitle: Charmlee Wilderness Park · 2577 Encinal Canyon Road, Malibu
cards.notes: Reserve a place for the City’s scheduled sunset hike, bring water and closed-toe shoes, and expect uneven terrain after dark.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled, registration-based free guided hike in Malibu.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Malibu lists its April 24, 2026 Charmlee Sunset Hike as free and describes it as a 90-minute walk on uneven terrain.
cards.source_title: Charmlee Sunset Hikes — City of Malibu
cards.access_notes: This listed hike is on April 24, 2026, 7–8:30 PM and requires registration; it is past as of the fetch date, so look for a current City session.

warnings: The Charmlee event is a documented free activity but its listed date has passed; use the City’s current calendar before planning.
For National Park Service hikes, zero-dollar status covers entrance only; transportation and some parking options may cost money.
